user.title: Set up Lommepenge
user.description: Home Assistant stores the family's tasks and pocket money. The app on the family screen, the parents' phones and the children's tablets connects here.

data_description.pin: Unlocks the parent part of the app on the family screen. The parents' phones open it without a PIN.
data_description.language: Language of entity names, lock reasons, notifications and the install page - independent of Home Assistant's language. Each device chooses its own language in the app.
data_description.currency: Written as you want it shown, e.g. DKK, kr, € or USD.

init.title: Lommepenge settings
init.description: Home Assistant fetches the app from the releases of this repository and hands new versions to the family's devices. A token is only needed for a private repository.

data.github_token: GitHub token (only for a private repository)
data.pin: New parent PIN (leave empty to keep)

data_description.language: Language of entity names, lock reasons, notifications and the install page - independent of Home Assistant's language.
data_description.currency: Written as you want it shown, e.g. DKK, kr, € or USD.

error.invalid_token: GitHub rejected the token, or it has no access to the repository.

user.title: Add device
user.description: Add the family screen, a parent's phone or a child's tablet.

child.title: Which child?
child.description: The tablet will only show this child's tasks.

pair.title: Add {name}
pair.description:
Code: **{code}** (works once, until {expires})

Install the app on the device, open it, choose Connect with code and enter the code. The app finds Home Assistant by itself.

[Open the page with the app download and QR code]({install_url})

Press Submit when the device is connected.

reconfigure.title: New code for {name}
reconfigure.description:
Code: **{code}** (works once, until {expires})

Use it after reinstalling the app: Connect with code in the app. The old connection stops when the device connects again.

[Open the page with the app download and QR code]({install_url})

abort.no_children: Create the child in the app first (on the family screen or a parent's phone).

approve.name: Approve task
approve.description: Approves a completed task so the amount is added to the child's balance.

reject.name: Reject task
reject.description: Rejects a completed task. The child can do it again.

reason.name: Reason
reason.description: Optional. Shown to the child in the notification.

lift_lock.name: Lift lock
lift_lock.description: Clears the child's pending and running lock. New overdue or rejected tasks can lock the tablet again.

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The child_id attribute of the child's "Tablet restricted" sensor.

pause.name: Pause tasks
pause.description: Pauses the child: no task is mandatory (no deadline, no lock), but the tasks still earn money. Also lifts the child's lock.

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The child_id attribute of the child's "Tablet restricted" sensor.

until.name: Until
until.description: The date the tasks are mandatory again (from midnight). Empty = until resumed.

resume.name: Resume tasks
resume.description: Ends the child's pause: the tasks are mandatory again from now.

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The child_id attribute of the child's "Tablet restricted" sensor.
